newsitem.title: USA: Dow Industrials higher in early trade.
newsitem.headline: Dow Industrials higher in early trade.

text.p: Wall Street stocks opened higher with bonds on Thursday one day after the Dow set its tenth record this month. Bonds rallied after the release of a higher than forecast weekly jobless claims report.
Dow industrials rose eight to 6,438. The long bond rose 4/32 to yield 6.40 percent.
